content.heading: Right to freedom of religion
content.text: Articles 25 to 28 guarantee freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion (subject to public order, morality, health and other Part III provisions, and to Article 25(2) State powers), freedom to manage religious affairs, freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion, and freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or worship in certain educational institutions. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-25 through art-28.
